Subject: Onsite workshop — travel routing, A/V liaison & concierge ops

Team —

We have final confirmation from Acme Health for the week-of Nov 29 executive workshop. They want a high-touch hybrid setup (two-way stage camera, gallery view for remote execs, and a private breakout for leadership). Key asks from my call with Lena: on-site AV liaison, attendee arrival routing (concierge pickup from arrivals), and a small green room for pre-briefs.

Immediate asks:
- Jonas: can you draft the AV liaison run-of-show (who owns on-site switching, A/V check at T-90 / T-30)?
- Marissa: coordinate travel routing with concierge and confirm airport pickup windows for 8 pax. Use the corporate travel vendor when possible.
- Rishi: flag any budget/expense policy issues for concierge + car service — quick yes/no so we can finalize procurement items.

Attachments I want in the first pass: rough attendee arrival windows, preferred hotel rooming blocks, and the breakout AV list. I pulled the initial venue options from Skyline but we still need a final selection.

I'll set a short sync for tomorrow at 10am PT to go through gap items.

Thanks,
Naomi

Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — travel routing, A/V liaison & concierge ops

Hi Naomi / Marissa —

Thanks for the details. We can support the hybrid layout you described. Summary of options and lead times: 

1) Standard Hybrid Package (included): gallery camera + room sound, 75" confidence display, wired stage mic, 1 onsite AV tech (8 hours).
2) Exec Broadcast Upgrade (+$2,200): dedicated PTZ stage camera with NDI feed, redundant encoder, live switching (ISO recording), 2 AV techs.
3) Remote Producer (+$900/day): remote operator who can manage Zoom layout and captions for the call.

We recommend the Exec Broadcast Upgrade for a C-suite panel: it reduces latency and gives a clean gallery feed for remote execs. See attached: skyline_av_options.pdf for a visual matrix and sample run-of-show.

Logistics notes:
- Green room (backstage) available in B2, 12x10, lockable.
- Loading dock access at 06:30 local; truck clearance requires us to have vendor IDs on file 48 hours prior.
- Concierge partner (Skyline Concierge) can provide arrival transfers — I can email them a template to fill in arrival windows.

If that works, I'll provisionally reserve the Exec Broadcast Upgrade and two techs pending procurement confirmation.

Regards,
Jason Kim
Operations Lead, Skyline Venues
ops@skylinevenues.com | +1 415-777-8812
